s0190: Basiron and Differin put the vast majority of their digital spend into **Online Video (96% and 94% respectively)** — a sign of focus on reach, awareness and audience warm-up. The aim is to widen the consumer base and build initial interest in the brands.
s0191: Zerkalin, the category’s biggest spender (**RUB 7.7M**), splits its budget between **Paid Search (56%)**, Online Video (34%) and Banners (8%) — a performance-led strategy.

s0219: The acne treatment market grew strongly, in both value and units. This confirms the category’s lasting relevance and high interest in acne solutions.
s0220: In January–July 2026, acne treatment sales reached **RUB 13.1 bn**, up 28% on the same period of 2025. In volume, the market is also growing — by **16%**.
s0221: Topical treatments remain the most popular choice, accounting for 69% of all units sold in the category. In value, however, systemic drugs (oral retinoids) already bring in over 55% of revenue, with isotretinoin still the main driver.
